references.context: Well-defined associative commutative binary addition with additive identity and inverses on integer elements.
Associative distributive multiplication with multiplicative identity 1 on integer elements.

references.disposition: Ring Z has its usual unital commutative structure and not all nonzero elements have multiplicative inverses.

review_rationale: Read ring of integers as the integer set equipped with ordinary addition and multiplication, distinct from a specific class representation and with ring axioms implicit.
